verdict.rationale: cubic documents auto-resolving threads, closing findings once the issue is fixed, which covers tracking what was fixed. Auto-fix applying to 'every review of a pull request' implies a PR gets reviewed more than once. The docs never say that pushing commits triggers an incremental re-review, or that old comments are not repeated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of push-triggered incremental re-review, explicit de-duplication of prior comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review that tracks what was fixed instead of repeating old comments

citations.quote: Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request
Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
